about_the_game:
Welcome to Evolution Survivors!

This is a roguelike action game that blends deep build-crafting with intense survival challenges.

■ Survive & Explore
Take control of the survivors, "Xiao Kui" or "Lao Chai," and fight for your life in perilous arenas. Each run presents a brand-new map with unique challenges.

■ Collect & Build
Gather mysterious energies to unlock powerful skills and essential survival gear. With multiple evolution branches for every active skill, a vast array of passives, and game-changing special ability cards, you can forge a combat style that is uniquely yours.

■ Challenge & Adapt
Your greatest trial lies in your enemies—they learn from your tactics, constantly evolving new attack patterns and resistances. You must stay one step ahead strategically to withstand each increasingly powerful onslaught.

■ Persevere & Unravel
Fight. Survive. Grow stronger. When you persevere to the very end, the truth behind this world's existence will finally be revealed to you.
